results.text: Profound hypotension following concomitant administration of tizanidine and lisinopril. Tizanidine, a muscle relaxant, exerts its mechanism as a centrally acting alpha-2 adrenergic receptor agonist and binds to imidazoline receptors. Bradycardia and hypotension are adverse effects associated with alpha-2 adrenergic receptor agonists. results.text: Effects of Sacubitril/Valsartan on Myocardial Tissue in Heart Failure With Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Below 50.
